resolution: Fixed the '[compose] material fn undefined' boot spam: fillSpec read m.fn off FillMaterial, which has no fn field ({slug,name,variants}), so all 409 fill specs composed with undefined, each logged an error, and each silently fell back to the full-catalog FILL_SHADER — meaning the fill-preview half of req_3473 had regressed to the megashader. Specs now resolve the WGSL fn via fnForMaterialRow(materialId, b.board) (the exact dispatch pair); compose.ts filters falsy fns, logs unknown names once each, and memoizes fallbacks so drift can never spam per-mount again. Added a suite guard asserting every generated fill spec carries fillFn and its own material body (10/10 green under v8cli). Lands via hot reload — startup should now be spam-free AND thumbnail mounts genuinely compile the small modules.
